scene_order_rule: Exactly C5_AXIS_COORDINATE_RUN_CONTRACT_V1.scene_ids with DL1018_VAL_T2_C00_W10 removed; preserve order; exactly eleven unique IDs.
pilot_rule: The first scene is already run and parent-reviewed. Its non-beat of B is not a scientific success and its metadata review does not authorize tail execution. This separate explicit tail release is required.
release_binding_rule: Bind this source binding, tail runner, launcher, tail contract, parent release contract, original C5 input lock/run contract/preparation/snapshot, the original first-scene release, all first-scene raw/status/run_start/marker/OS/receipt/outer-invocation/review artifacts, and the B72 manifest/parent review/batch/lock/contract/preparation/release identities.
execution_rule: One PowerShell 7 invocation starts one MATLAB process; one shared heavy-job lock is held across all eleven scenes. The first failure stops the batch. Never overwrite or retry. The launcher writes shared per-scene exit records only after the single MATLAB process naturally returns OS 0 and all eleven scenes are complete.
resource_rule: The 1-GiB C5 experiment-directory cap includes the existing pilot. Before launch and before every scene reserve 80,000,000 bytes for each remaining scene, retain at least 30,000,000,000 bytes of free disk after reservation, and require at least 180 seconds per remaining scene plus a 600-second process-exit buffer before the 2026-10-24T17:01:00Z deadline.
outcome_rule: The preregistered 12-scene comparison gates and full-precision tolerances remain unchanged. A failed gate rejects the fixed candidate; no tuning, replacement scenes, or DEV72 extension.
